lines.text: Jesus went with His disciples across the Kidron Valley into a garden, a place Judas knew because Jesus often met there.
Judas brought soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
Jesus stepped forward and asked whom they sought, and when He said "I am He," they drew back and fell to the ground.
Jesus told the soldiers to take Him but let His disciples go, fulfilling His word that He had not lost one.
Peter struck the servant Malchus and cut off his left ear, and Jesus told him to put his sword away.
